prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Houston, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1380; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Before we begin, do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Good. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?

A: I was driving westbound on a main road in Houston, stopped at a traffic light near an intersection with a shopping center on the corner.

Q: What happened next?

A: The light was red, and I had been stopped for maybe ten or fifteen seconds. Then I felt a hard jolt from behind. My head snapped forward and back, and my car was pushed into the vehicle in front of me.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: Not really. I checked my mirror earlier, but I didn't see it come up. I only heard the brakes squeal a moment before it hit.

Q: Did you notice any injuries right after the collision?

A: My head and neck were sore, but the big problem was my right knee. It hit the dashboard, and it swelled up pretty quickly. I could barely put weight on it when I tried to get out of the car.

Q: Have you received any medical treatment since then?

A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic that same day, and they referred me to an orthopedic doctor. I've had two appointments so far, and I'm scheduled for physical therapy.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I've been having trouble driving and sleeping because of the pain. I want to make sure my knee gets properly treated.

Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
